_comment: Over-used material for the-power-of-moments, MOVED out of the universal section contracts by P07. Writer guidance only; over-use is enforced by SEC/AS gates.
phrases: free popsicles on a silver tray
frames: classify a transition/milestone/pit, choose an elevation/insight/pride/connection lever, then predict an attention/meaning/memory shift
framework triads stamped across chapters instead of chapter-specific thresholds, earned markers, low points, repairs, or relationship turns
the "attention, meaning, or memory" proof loop used as a generic close
notes: Named public cases this book anonymizes into periphrastic tells instead of naming or describing plainly: John Deere ("a Moline-based equipment company"), Disney parks / evening spectacular, Southwest Airlines / playful safety routines, the Magic Castle Hotel ("a Los Angeles hotel"), YES Prep ("a Houston public charter network").
When a source fact mentions peak-end memory, turn it into the dealt sceneFrame's concrete action rather than another "pleasant average versus memorable peak/ending" tradeoff.
